messages:
Noor Malik: Dropping a tiny dark-mode pass for the Insights compact header + charts. Main asks: make legend chips readable on small widths, ensure inline `code` tokens pop in the details drawer, and pick series colors that survive screenshots/prints. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzcompact (preview).

Owen Grant: Nice start. Quick notes: legend is 12px and thin on #0c0f12  either bump to 13px semibold or raise contrast. The mustard/yellow series disappears in photocopies.

Priya Shah: For inline code, current bg flattens tokens. Suggest inline bg rgba(255,255,255,0.03) + 1px inner stroke rgba(255,255,255,0.04). Token palette proposal: keyword #8beaff, fn #bde8b0, string #ffd79a, number #ffb77a. Block code uses slightly darker bg and 8px padding.

Marta Ruiz: Accessibility: legend toggles must be keyboard-focusable with visible halo (2px). aria-pressed should reflect toggle state. Hit targets should be at least 28px on mobile. Also add patterned-line variants (dash/dot) for color-ambiguous series so greyscale copies remain readable.

Owen Grant: Proposed compact palette (aim >=4.5:1 vs bg #0c0f12): --blue: #4ea8ff; --warm: #ffb879; --lavender: #c8b3ff; --mint: #7ef0c7; legend-text: #eaf4ff.

ContrastBot: Automated audit: current mustard vs bg => 2.5:1 (FAIL). proposed warm (#ffb879) => 5.2:1 (PASS). legend-text vs bg => 6.9:1 (PASS). focus halo currently missing (FAIL).

Noor Malik: I'll update Figma tokens, add dashed-line variants, and include the inline code stroke sample. Planning a micro PR with theme JSON, focus util, and the small tooltip copy tweak ("Toggle series visibility"). Will tag QA for export checks.

Priya Shah: Added comments in Figma with token names and sample code styles. Left a note about export: patterned lines must be respected in PNG/PDF outputs.

Marta Ruiz: One extra nit: tooltip copy should be explicit for screen readers. Use aria-label="Toggle visibility for <series name>".

Noor Malik: Thanks all  merging after QA green. Closing thread when PR is merged. :rocket:
